channel.title: Qulo Blog
channel.description: How people actually meet, and what happens when matching runs on questions instead of photos.

item.title: How to answer a question well — the half nobody writes about
item.description: Every guide tells you which questions to ask. Almost none tells you how to answer one, even though the answer is the half that decides whether the question was worth asking — and that half has been measured too.

item.title: Does having too many options make dating worse?
item.description: The general paradox-of-choice claim did not survive its own meta-analysis. What the dating research actually measured is narrower: not a loss of happiness, but a shift in what you pay attention to.

item.title: Is cuffing season real? What the research actually says
item.description: Every autumn the same story: the cold pushes single people together. The research it gets attributed to describes a six-month cycle with two peaks, and a mechanism that has nothing to do with romance.

item.title: The Question Deficit: Why You Both Left Thinking the Other One Wasn't Curious
item.description: You left thinking the other person wasn’t curious about you. They left thinking exactly the same about you. Both of you are sincere — we all ask fewer questions than we believe we do, and what earns a second date is the follow-up: the question built out of what the other person just said.

item.title: Why “Hey” Gets Ignored: The Psychology of a First Message That Gets a Reply
item.description: A bare greeting asks for nothing, so it gets nothing back. Harvard’s conversation research shows what actually earns a reply — and how Qulo builds that question into every match.

item.title: Your 'Type' Doesn't Predict Love: What Actually Predicts Compatibility
item.description: Decades of relationship science are clear: the 'type' you think you want doesn't predict who you'll actually connect with. So what really predicts compatibility — and why does it mean most dating apps are built backwards?

item.title: Dating Apps Without Swiping: A Complete Guide for 2026
item.description: Tired of the swipe mechanic? You have alternatives. A complete guide to question-based, AI-powered, and interaction-focused dating apps.

item.title: Why Introverts Are Choosing Quiz Dating Over Swipe Apps
item.description: Do dating apps overwhelm you as an introvert? Discover why quiz dating is ideal for introverts and how Qulo makes a difference.

item.title: The Science Behind Question-Based Matching: Why Questions Beat Photos
item.description: Psychology research shows that questions build much stronger connections than superficial attraction. Here's the scientific foundation of question-based matching.

item.title: 5 Signs You Have Dating App Burnout (And What to Do About It)
item.description: Feeling burned out from dating apps? Here are 5 signs of dating app burnout and ways to break free from the cycle.

item.title: Online Dating Safety Guide: 10 Golden Rules
item.description: Online dating can be safe — if you take the right steps. Here are 10 golden rules you need to know to protect yourself on dating apps.

item.title: Quiz Dating: Is the Future of Matching in Questions?
item.description: While swipe-based matching remains superficial, question-based dating is rising as a new trend. What is quiz dating and why does it lead to deeper connections?

item.title: What is Swipe Fatigue and Why is Everyone Tired of It?
item.description: If you're tired of endlessly swiping left and right on dating apps, you're not alone. What is swipe fatigue, why does it happen, and how does Qulo solve it?
